files.site.yml:
---
- name: Configure web tier
  hosts: web:&prod
  gather_facts: true
  vars_files:
    - vars/{{ env_name }}.yml
  vars:
    app_name: shop
    app_root: "/srv/{{ app_name }}"
    listen_port: "{{ http_port | default(80) }}"
    upstreams: "{{ groups['app'] | map('extract', hostvars, 'ansible_host') | list }}"
    packages: [nginx, curl, "{{ extra_pkg | default(omit) }}"]
  pre_tasks:
    - name: Show who we are
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ inventory_hostname }} in {{ group_names | join(',') }} ({{ env_name }})"

  roles:
    - common
    - role: nginx
      vars:
        nginx_worker_processes: 4

  tasks:
    - name: Install packages
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        state: present
      loop: "{{ packages | reject('equalto', omit) | list }}"

    - name: Create app dirs
      file: path={{ app_root }}/{{ item.key }} state=directory mode={{ item.value }}
      with_dict: "{{ app_dirs }}"

    - name: Check app health
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: "http://localhost:{{ listen_port }}/health"
        status_code: 200
      register: health
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Remember build
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        build_tag: "{{ app_name }}-{{ release | default('latest') }}"
        healthy: "{{ health.status == 200 }}"

    - name: Report only if unhealthy
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Health returned {{ health.status }}"
      when: not healthy

    - name: Deploy release
      block:
        - name: Fetch artifact
          ansible.builtin.get_url:
            url: "{{ artifact_url }}/{{ build_tag }}.tar.gz"
            dest: "/tmp/{{ build_tag }}.tar.gz"
            timeout: "{{ download_timeout }}"
        - ansible.builtin.include_tasks: tasks/migrate.yml
          when: run_migrations | bool
      rescue:
        - name: Roll back
          ansible.builtin.command: /usr/local/bin/rollback {{ app_name }}
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Debian-only tweak
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/sysctl.conf
        line: "net.core.somaxconn = {{ somaxconn }}"
      when:
        - env_name == 'prod'
        - ansible_distribution_major_version | int >= 11
      notify: reload sysctl

  handlers:
    - name: reload sysctl
      ansible.builtin.command: sysctl -p
files.inventory.ini:
[web]
web[01:02].example.com ansible_user=deploy

[app]
app1 ansible_host=10.0.0.11
app2 ansible_host=10.0.0.12

[prod:children]
web
app

[prod:vars]
env_name=prod
files.group_vars/all.yml:
http_port: 8080
artifact_url: "https://artifacts.{{ domain }}/{{ app_name }}"
domain: example.com
app_dirs:
  releases: "0755"
  shared: "0750"
run_migrations: "yes"
somaxconn: 1024
files.roles/common/tasks/main.yml:
- name: Set timezone
  community.general.timezone:
    name: "{{ common_timezone }}"

- name: Create users
  ansible.builtin.user:
    name: "{{ u.name }}"
    groups: "{{ u.groups | join(',') }}"
    append: true
  loop: "{{ common_users }}"
  loop_control:
    loop_var: u
    label: "{{ u.name }}"
files.roles/nginx/tasks/main.yml:
- name: Render nginx.conf
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: nginx.conf.j2
    dest: "{{ nginx_conf_dir }}/nginx.conf"
    owner: root
    mode: "0644"
    validate: nginx -t -c %s
  notify: restart nginx

- name: TLS settings
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    dest: "{{ nginx_conf_dir }}/conf.d/tls.conf"
    content: |
      ssl_protocols {{ nginx_tls_protocols | join(' ') }};
  when: tls_enabled | default(false)
files.roles/nginx/handlers/main.yml:
- name: restart nginx
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: nginx
    state: restarted
